description: Read a procedure title, stage, events, participants, or linked parliamentary documents. Default section overview returns scalar fields and collection counts; events, participants, and documents page one selected collection. Continue with page.next_offset and the returned snapshot; restart at offset 0 without snapshot if the collection changes. Historical participation groups remain historical. Missing detail succeeds with found false; discover references with euparl_list_procedures. Linked documents can be read with euparl_search_documents mode get; files are linked, not parsed.

language.description: Supported EU ISO-639-1 language, case-insensitive; default en; source text is never translated.

limit.description: Whole items requested; default 20, effective maximum 100 with notice.

procedure_id.description: Procedure YYYY-NNNN or YYYY/NNNN, optional letter suffix and (TYPE), known eli/dl/proc/ prefix or exact public procedure URI.

section.description: Default overview returns scalars and counts; choose a collection for complete paged items.

snapshot.description: Previous collection snapshot; required for local offset above 0, optional at offset 0.

name: euparl_get_procedure

appliedFilters.description: Actual normalized retrieval scope and filters.

available.description: Whether the selected source array was published, including a published empty array.

available_sections.description: Section counts on a found overview only.

items.description: Available section and parsed item count.

count.description: Exact parsed collection size; absence of relations does not prove no activity.

documents.description: Selected deduplicated linked-document page, present only for documents.

items.description: Explicit linked parliamentary document; no inferred title or legal identifier.

document_id.description: Canonical document identifier for euparl_search_documents mode get.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: Identifier, citation type or language is unsupported or conflicts with the published procedure. `invalid_mode_fields`: Overview has a nonzero offset, or collection continuation lacks its snapshot. `snapshot_changed`: The complete selected collection or its retrieval scope changed. `upstream_rejected`: Parliament rejects validated request parameters. `upstream_rate_limited`: Parliament rate limits persist after bounded retries. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

events.description: Selected event page, present only for the events section.

activity_type.description: Published activity type code or URI.

document_ids.description: Explicit event document relations, deduplicated in first-seen order.

sitting_ids.description: Explicit scheduled sitting relations; when absent, a published vote-event date can select a sitting for euparl_get_plenary_votes decisions with document_id.

notice.description: Publication, language fallback, empty-result or continuation guidance.

page.description: Selected collection continuation; absent on overview or missing detail.

has_more.description: Whether more matches are known or cannot be ruled out; a search window may prevent continuation.

limit.description: Effective whole-item page size, at most 100.

next_offset.description: Usable next offset when continuation is accessible; absent at a search-window boundary even if has_more is true.

offset.description: Zero-based position in the selected collection.

returned.description: Number of complete items on this page.

snapshot.description: Digest of the complete normalized local collection and scope; reuse for continuation.

participants.description: Selected historical participation page, present only for participants.

political_group_id.description: Published historical political group; never joined to a current group.

represented_organization_id.description: Published organization represented by this participation.

shown.description: Whole items shown on this partial page.

title.description: Published procedure title in the actual selected language.

language.description: Actual language of the published text.

totalCount.description: Exact count only when published or computed over a complete collection.

truncated.description: True when this page returns only part of the selected collection.

title: Read a parliamentary procedure
